IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Dunshee, Pearson, Lovick, Kristiansen, Berkey, Sullivan and Wood

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring vehicle sound system components to be securely attached.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle sound system equipment; and adding a newsection to chapter 46.37 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.37 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All vehicle sound system components, including any supplementalspeaker systems or components, must be securely attached to the vehicleregardless of where the components are located, so that the componentscannot become dislodged or loose during operation of the vehicle. (2) Enforcement of this section by law enforcement officers may beaccomplished only as a secondary action when a driver of a vehicle hasbeen detained for a suspected violation of this title or an equivalentlocal ordinance or some other offense.
